_about: Robert Wodrow (1679-1734), minister of Eastwood: The History of the Sufferings of the Church of Scotland from the Restoration to the Revolution, ed. Robert Burns, with a memoir of the author (Glasgow: Blackie, Fullarton, 1828-1830, 4 vols); his Correspondence (Wodrow Society, 1842-1843, 3 vols); the Analecta (Maitland Club, 1842-1843, 4 vols); and the Collections upon the Lives of the Reformers (Maitland Club, 1834-1845, 2 vols; dates as on the title pages). The two Collections scans come from the National Library of Scotland, which licenses its digital copies CC BY-NC-SA 2.5 Scotland: the 18th-century text is public domain, the non-commercial term is on the scan, and it is noted here, not ruled on. Volume numbers read off each title page. Named robert-wodrow so it is not confused with the wodrow-society shelf, which holds the Society's collective volume. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
